# Commands Implement/Try recovery and visible style evidence

For selected-rebase parent anchors, suppress a duplicate only when stable identity (`TB-Tools-Id`/Differential Revision) and nonempty `git patch-id --stable` both match; rebased hashes alone do not establish a distinct patch. `getGraphCommitPatchId()` is the existing comparison primitive. [Task 3]

Scope: console.
